narrative.overview:
This project does not have its own visual world. It is FTDS v0.2.0, the Ministry of Finance's design system, applied twice: to the agency websites the builder publishes, and to the admin officers use to run them. The North Star, palette, type, elevation and component rules come from the FTDS DESIGN.md, which is the authority for anything this file doesn't say. The tokens above are FTDS's light theme, copied so tools can read them; `styles/ftds.css` in each app is the source they come from.

What this file adds is how FTDS is used here. The two surfaces share every token and differ only in density: published sites are FTDS at its comfortable default, built for visitors on older phones; the admin is compact, for officers at a desk. Both are quiet on purpose. Structure comes from spacing and tone, one blue marks the way forward, and nothing is decorated. On the published sites that calm is enforced: officers arrange approved blocks and pick preset variants, so no page can drift from the system.
keyCharacteristics: FTDS as installed, with no project palette, font or radius of its own.
Comfortable density on published sites, compact density in the admin, from the same tokens.
Light theme only, on both surfaces, for now.
Inter, self-hosted, so neither surface makes a third-party font request.
Pages in the admin are shown as they really render, never as a mock-up.

rules.name: The Tokens-Only Rule
rules.body: Every colour comes from an FTDS token (`bg-bg-*`, `text-txt-*`, `border-otl-*`). No raw Tailwind colours, no hex values in components, no `dark:` overrides. If FTDS lacks a piece, build it from these tokens.

rules.name: The Light-Only Rule
rules.body: Both surfaces are light only for now: the admin sets `color-scheme: light` and ignores the OS preference, and published sites never switch. The dark tokens in the vendored CSS stay unused until dark mode is decided as a whole.

rules.name: The Floor Rule
rules.body: Nothing below 13px, and 13px only in the compact admin. Visitor-facing text starts at 16px. Weights are 400, 500 and 600 only.

rules.name: The Phone-Order Rule
rules.body: Write an admin screen in the order a phone should read it, then place blocks on wide screens with grid placement. Never reorder content with CSS so that the visual order and the reading order differ on a phone.

dos: **Do** read the FTDS DESIGN.md before building anything new; it governs everything this file doesn't mention.
**Do** use FTDS components before writing your own, and build anything missing from FTDS tokens.
**Do** keep published sites in comfortable density and the admin in compact density.
**Do** show a page in the admin with the page frame, from the real renderer.
**Do** carry every page and publish state as a wash tag with words.
**Do** write every admin string through `t()`; site content and FTDS Astro labels are BM by default.
donts: **Don't** add a project palette, typeface, radius or shadow; this project has none of its own.
**Don't** use raw Tailwind colours, hex values or `dark:` overrides.
**Don't** give officers a way to style content on published sites: no colour pickers, font choices, free spacing or custom HTML. Variants are presets.
**Don't** turn on the dark theme on either surface until it is decided for both.
**Don't** put two filled blue buttons on one screen.
